aboutSchool: RESIDENTIAL PDS PUBLIC SCHOOL SHEOHAR is a premier co-educational residential institution operating under Affiliation Code 10030206405. Strategically situated at BRC Near Shahpur Road, Sheohar (Ward No. 14), Bihar - 843329, our campus provides a tranquil, protected, and intellectually vibrant atmosphere for boys and girls.
academicIntro: Following CBSE curriculum guidelines from Nursery through Class 8, combining scholastic excellence with co-scholastic holistic development.
campusIntro: Modern multi-acre campus featuring digital smart classrooms, composite science laboratories, high-speed computer lab, rich library, and expansive sports grounds.
chairmanMessage: When we laid the foundation stone of Residential PDS Public School Sheohar, our vision was clear: to bring top-tier education right to the doorsteps of our children in Sheohar so they do not need to migrate to distant cities. We have invested tirelessly in smart infrastructure, experienced teachers, and disciplined residential boarding to make this institution a beacon of hope.
mission: To provide a stimulating learning environment through modern instructional techniques, dedicated residential mentorship, and state-of-the-art facilities that unlock the full intellectual, physical, and emotional potential of every student.
missionPoints: Strong foundation in STEM, languages, and analytical reasoning
Zero-tolerance for indiscipline; fostering honesty and empathy
Safe, supportive residential home away from home with 24x7 supervision
principalMessage: At Residential PDS Public School, we nurture not just academic aptitude, but character, resilience, and curiosity. Our faculty works hand-in-hand with parents to identify each student's strengths, whether in science, mathematics, literature, or athletic sports. I warmly welcome every parent to visit our campus and join our inspiring academic family.
residentialLife: Comfortable, safe, and disciplined boarding hostels with dedicated wardens, regular health checkups, hygienic meals, and daily supervised evening study hours.
vision: To be a premier center of educational excellence in Bihar that nurtures young minds into responsible, intellectually enlightened, and morally grounded leaders. We envision every child equipped with critical thinking, scientific curiosity, and a deep sense of social responsibility.
visionPoints: Nurturing academic excellence without commercial compromise
Instilling Indian moral values, humility, and national pride
Empowering students from rural and semi-urban regions to compete globally
